recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source action is needed for FHIR-17990 unless FM opens a new current-version editorial issue specifically about PaymentNotice.recipient wording; do not use FHIR-17990 to override the later reporter decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17990 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by FM and requested PaymentNotice long-description changes: change the old PaymentNotice.target wording to identify the party intended to receive the notice, and change the old PaymentNotice.provider wording away from practitioner-specific language toward provider wording.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged batch commit f369c813fb40cd39c0db46336b2b3186f496fb47 included GF#17990 and revised PaymentNotice spreadsheet/example source during the R3-to-R4 financial resource update. It removed the old target element in favor of recipient, updated the example from target to recipient, and carried forward recipient wording as the party notified of payment status. The old provider wording remained until later current-build work.
additional_context: PaymentNotice is active in the current build. source/fhir.ini maps old PaymentNotice.target to current PaymentNotice.recipient and maps PaymentNotice.provider to current PaymentNotice.reporter. FHIR-40448 later made a final FM decision to rename provider to reporter and update its active-build description; that later decision is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current PaymentNotice.recipient already conveys the intended notice recipient role, and current PaymentNotice.reporter uses the later approved generic reporting-party wording, so editing current source based on obsolete STU3 element names would be unnecessary and could conflict with later approved work.

related_jiras.note: Later final FM decision renamed PaymentNotice.provider to PaymentNotice.reporter and corrected the active-build description, superseding the old provider/practitioner wording for current source.
